よろしくお願い致します！

I am a Vtuber active on the Bilibili platform, and I truly admire your artwork. It would be an honor if I could commission you for a piece!  

[Character Introduction]The character I’d like to commission is a little devil who used to work at an intelligence agency. However, due to poverty, she sold off some classified information and is now a wanted fugitive. Although her combat skills are weak, she is cunning, greedy, and mischievous — yet still very cute. It would be amazing if her personality traits could be reflected in the artwork!  

[Artwork Content]Please freely decide the character’s pose.

[Usage of the Artwork]The commissioned artwork will be used as custom gifts for my channel members and for promotional purposes on social media. To better optimize the website layout, could you please complete the character on the left side of the image? If your schedule allows, I would greatly appreciate it if you could consider this request. Thank you very much!

すえちむ氏、こんばんは
もし宜しければ、私のオリジナルキャラクターを描いていただきたいです。

彼女は海賊で、自分のやり方を貫く、冷静かつ楽観的な性格の持ち主です。幽霊船の船長で、船上には誰もおらず、退屈を嫌うあまり、誰もいない空間に向かって延々と話し続けることがあります。

特徴：
穏やかで落ち着いた雰囲気を持ち、目尻が下がっているのが特徴です。身長は約168センチで、燃えるような赤い髪と、湖水を思わせる美しい緑の瞳を持っています。

もし不明な点がございましたら、自由に調整していただいて構いません。また、装飾品や衣装、髪型のアレンジや簡略化もご自由にどうぞ。

使用について
・自分鑑賞用
